subject: Re: FVD workstream kickoff — one metric for video gen
body:
Hi Lucia,

Plan: Quentin full-time on the metric library, Katya at 50% for model-repo integration, Tereza at 30% for infra.

Compute: day-to-day dev fits on titan-a100 best-effort. For the June calibration sweep we are covered — we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-06-08, 256 accelerators, which is sized for the full sweep across model families and seeds. I have put the reservation ID in the tracker; Ines, cc'ing you for awareness.

One dependency: the reference pipeline assumes clips shaped [NUMBER_OF_VIDEOS, VIDEO_LENGTH, 224, 224, 3] with values in 0-255; our internal stores are float-normalized, so Katya is writing a conversion shim first.

Daniela
